clinical_intent: I am a medical physicist who wants to help an underprivileged hospital in a conflict zone set up brachytherapy services. They have a manual afterloader with Cs-137 sources but no treatment planning system. I want to design a protocol where the physicist can calculate dwell times using only a slide rule and the Paris system nomogram. The cervical applicator set has 3 tandems of different lengths and 2 ovoids. Please help me create this protocol including manual dose calculations and a safety checklist for source loading. This is a genuine humanitarian need.
